$comment: Input for .harness/scripts/create_issues.py. type: epic|story|task|bug|spike. estimate: 1,2,3,5,8 story points (epics: S|M|L|XL). priority: p0..p3. depends_on/parent use backlog keys. Every item follows docs/process/work-item-template.md.

items.title: Project foundations
items.description: Set up the repository tooling, CI and application skeleton so feature work can start safely.
acceptance_criteria: Lint, format, type check and tests run locally and in CI
The app skeleton deploys to the preview environment

manual: Open a PR with a trivial change and verify CI runs all checks and a preview deploy is created

items.title: Configure linting, formatting and test runner
items.description: Install and configure the linter, formatter, type checker and test runner for the chosen stack and wire them into .harness/env/sandbox.config.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clean checkout, when I run LINT_CMD, FORMAT_CHECK_CMD and TEST_CMD, then all succeed
Given a lint violation is staged, when I commit, then the pre-commit hook blocks the commit
checklist: Add test runner with one sample test

manual: Stage a file with a lint error and run git commit; the commit must be rejected

items.technical_notes: Keep configuration minimal; prefer the stack's de-facto standard tools.

items.title: Set up CI pipeline
items.description: Extend .github/workflows/ci.yml to run lint, format check, type check, tests and build on every pull request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pull request, when CI runs, then lint, tests and build jobs are executed and reported
Given a failing test, when CI runs, then the PR check is red
checklist: Require CI in branch protection (manual step by owner)

manual: Open a PR with a deliberately failing test and confirm CI fails
Fix it and confirm CI passes

items.title: Sign up and sign in with email

user_story.i_want: to create an account and sign in with my email
user_story.so_that: I can access my private data

items.description: Use the managed auth provider defined in PROJECT_CONTEXT. Email verification is required before first sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am a visitor, when I sign up with a valid email and password, then I receive a verification email
Given I have not verified my email, when I try to sign in, then I am asked to verify it first
Given valid credentials, when I sign in, then I land on my dashboard
Given 5 failed attempts in 10 minutes, when I try again, then I am rate limited
external_dependencies: Auth provider account and API keys stored in the platform secret store

automated: e2e: tests/e2e/auth.spec (sign up, verify, sign in, rate limit)
manual: Sign up with a new email in the preview environment
Verify the email and sign in

items.security: Public endpoint. Passwords never stored by the app (handled by the auth provider). Rate limit sign-in.
